title: Fyxer 如何打造值得信赖的 AI 行政助理
summary: Fyxer 利用 OpenAI 的模型、微调技术、记忆机制以及真实用户反馈，构建了一款能够整理收件箱并以用户个人风格起草电子邮件的 AI 行政助理。该产品通过持续学习用户偏好和写作习惯，旨在提供高度个性化的邮件管理体验，从而提升工作效率并赢得用户信任。
summary_en: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user's voice. The product aims to provide a highly personalized email management experience by continuously learning user preferences and writing styles, thereby improving efficiency and building trust.
